topic.title: BUG: "Player 1's deck error" at Step 0 with mathematically valid 60-card deck

messages.content:
Hello team,

I am encountering an immediate crash when submitting my agent. The simulation terminates at Step 0 with the following JSON output:

"status": "INVALID", "error": "Player 1's deck error."

I have attached my exact deck list in the deck.py file. I have manually verified that the list strictly follows all official TCG rules:

  • Exactly 60 cards (16 Pokémon, 34 Trainers, 10 Basic Energies)
  • Maximum of 4 copies per card name (I specifically balanced the Mega Charizard X and Y IDs so they do not exceed 4 copies combined).
  • Exactly 1 ACE SPEC (Precious Trolley - ID 1126).

Any insights into how the engine is parsing these specific IDs would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you!
